create.name: Tuere Sala
create.bio:
Tuere Sala is a vipassana teacher in Seattle, where she founded the Capitol Hill Meditation Group and serves as one of the guiding teachers of Seattle Insight Meditation Society. She came to teaching after a career as a prosecuting attorney, has practised insight meditation for more than thirty years, and has taught since 2010. She trained in the IMS teacher programme and now also co-chairs the guiding teachers' council at Spirit Rock.

Her focus is lay practice in the thick of ordinary city life rather than in a monastery: helping people set up a daily sitting habit that lasts, and bringing the Dharma into settings where it is rarely heard. Metta and the other heart qualities run through much of her teaching. With Phillip Moffitt as her mentor she took up Nine Bodies Insight, a practice that uses the many dimensions of consciousness as its object, and she is a founding teacher of Dharma Ground, a non-profit that offers online classes and retreats in that method by donation. She teaches daylongs and retreats for IMS in Barre and online, and her talks are widely shared by insight centres across the United States.

courses.title: Understanding the Strength of Metta
courses.description: An online IMS daylong taught by Tuere Sala on how lovingkindness, often thought of as softness, can become a real source of strength in practice and in character. The day mixes dharma talks, guided meditation and discussion, and is recorded for registered participants.

courses.title: Living Dharma: Essential Teachings for Our Times (Livestream Retreat 2027)
courses.description: A five-night retreat streamed from the IMS meditation hall, taught by Tuere Sala with bruni dávila and Walt Opie. It covers the core teachings, including mindfulness, the four noble truths, the hindrances and the heart practices, and is aimed especially at newer meditators.

courses.title: Befriending the Hindrances: On-Demand Class Series
courses.description: Recorded talks and guided meditations from Dharma Ground, available as soon as you register, with an optional live session with Tuere Sala on 22 November 2026. The series looks at meeting the hindrances with friendliness rather than struggle, drawing on Nine Bodies practice.
